deep.reconstruction:
There is no mathematics on this page. Folio 18v carries no text of its own. What shows is the ink of the other side of the leaf (f.18 recto, the 'previous page') bleeding through, so it reads mirror-reversed. A small ink blot is visible near the top.

The content is therefore identical to the recto: an administrative list dated Göttingen, January 1857. It records the letters of H. C. Schumacher to Gauss that were sent from Gauss's manuscript estate (Nachlass) to C. A. F. Peters in Altona. Peters was then preparing the edition of the Gauss–Schumacher correspondence, published 1860–65.

The list has 32 'Hefte' (bundles):
- Heft 1: 61 letters, 1808–1819.
- Hefte 2–32: one bundle per year, 1820–1850.
- Total: 803 letters, 1808–1850.
- Also sent to Peters: a few letters from Peters to Gauss, 1853–1854.

The only 'computation' is the total. Using the recto values, the yearly counts are 61, 5, 15, 8, 18, 23, 18, 18, 19, 17, 10, 11, 15, 8, 8, 18, 19, 35, 20, 14, 31, 32, 18, 29, 36, 58, 51, 62, 55, 17, 21, 33. My own check is that these do sum to 803, matching the stated 'Summa'. The page is likely a Nachlass-administration record rather than Riemann's own mathematics; whose hand it is cannot be settled from the show-through.
errors: No errors in the document itself: the 32 counts as read on the recto sum exactly to the stated total of 803.
Several readings in this page's machine transcription break that sum (see corrections), so those readings, not the original, are wrong.

transcription_corrections: This page is only show-through of f.18r. The authoritative text is the recto transcription; this verso should be catalogued as blank (bleed-through only).
Recto values sum exactly to 803. The verso transcription's readings 11 (1823), 13 (1825), 6 (1832), 35 (1844), 53 (1847) and 27 (1849) should therefore be 18, 18, 8, 58, 55 and 21 respectively.
The date is more likely 'Jan. 24' (as on the recto) than 'Jan. 20'.
Read 'verliehen worden sind' rather than 'übersendet worden sind' (recto reading; the mirror image is consistent with 'verliehen').
The number of Peters-to-Gauss letters (1853–1854) is read as 5 on the recto but 3 here. It cannot be settled from the show-through; consult the recto.
